of: Lofty's App Design System (LoftySupport/loftybrand, main, 5 October 2026)
Amber's decisions of 4 and 5 October 2026 in loftyprojectapp docs/ui-system

tokens.name: crisp-orange
tokens.usage: Core brand colour and the primary colour for interactive elements (Amber, 5 October 2026, C07). Always Deep Eco ink on it, 6.8:1; white on it is 2.6:1 and fails. Never body text on white.

tokens.name: orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover step of orange fills (App Design System value). 3.6:1 on white, so only behind large or bold labels.

tokens.name: orange-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of orange fills, link hover, and orange-toned icons or links on light surfaces (4.5:1 on white, 4.1:1 on Shell).

tokens.name: deep-eco
tokens.usage: Near-black. All text on light surfaces and the ink on orange and Current. White on it 17:1.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Accent: the AI mark, AI-led tiles and feature cards. Never a page ground. White on it 18:1, orange on it 6.9:1.

tokens.name: eco-green
tokens.usage: Accent: Next up and schedule cards, secondary filled surfaces, the Complete status. White on it 9.2:1.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Movement: background glows, trend lines, progress fills, the Log a site visit tile. Deep Eco ink on it; white only for icons or 24px+ type (3.4:1). Never text on white.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Warm light surface and the Sunrise page ground under the orange glows. Also brand and print.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft fills: avatars, quiet chart bars. Deep Eco ink on it.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Highlights on dark: eyebrow text on Eco Green, glow on light pages, avatars. Deep Eco ink on it.

tokens.name: eco-night
tokens.usage: Deep Eco dark page ground: near-black with a green cast. White on it 20:1.

tokens.name: twilight
tokens.usage: Twilight dark page ground: near-black with a plum cast. White on it 20:1.

tokens.name: foundation-black
tokens.usage: Brand kit primary and the App Design System's former text colour. Only the black lockup carries it now: text ink is Deep Eco on every surface, the Hub, the portal and documents included (Amber, 5 October 2026).

tokens.name: finisher-white
tokens.usage: Brand kit. Solid cards and the prompt box in Sunrise; the white lockup and mark on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mid-gray
tokens.usage: Brand kit. Logo and print only. Never a UI border or fill (App Design System rule, kept).

tokens.name: plum-lift
tokens.usage: Plum for blocks and tiles on the page. Plum holds on eco-night; on twilight it disappears, so it lifts to #4A0C32. White on it 15:1.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The page ground under the glass frame: Shell in Sunrise, eco-night in Deep Eco, twilight in Twilight.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on page, glass and card surfaces. 16:1 on Shell, 20:1 on the dark pages.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps, placeholders. 5.4:1 on Shell, 5.9:1 on white, 4.8:1 on `surface-selected`; 7.8:1 on eco-night.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and controls: ink at 40%, the App Design System's disabled opacity. Exempt from the contrast floor, so never for content people must read. Confirmed by Amber, 5 October 2026.

tokens.name: surface-frame
tokens.usage: The frosted app frame that holds rail, panels and main area. Pair with blur-frame.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Side panels: the AppRail, chat history and Your day.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Starter cards and answer widgets on the frame.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: The prompt box, search and form fields. Solid white in Sunrise so typing stays crisp.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Solid cards that must stand off the ground: kanban cards, widgets, tables, file lists, watch lists, modals.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, nav item, tab or option: a peach tint on light, a white wash on dark, one token per theme (Amber, 5 October 2026, C11). Ink stays `ink`. Replaces Momentum's white and the App Design System's two values.

tokens.name: surface-selected-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a selected item (App Design System values for peach and the on-dark wash).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral hover wash behind ghost buttons, icon buttons, menu and table rows. The App Design System rule with Deep Eco as the ink; white at 12% on dark. Confirmed by Amber, 5 October 2026.

tokens.name: edge-glass
tokens.usage: 1px edge on frame, panels and cards so glass reads as a surface. Decorative: carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels, table rules, ring and tab tracks, recessed fills. Decorative: carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: inputs, ghost buttons, chips, the prompt box, one token in every theme (Amber, 5 October 2026, C10). 3.1:1 on Shell, 3.5:1 on white, 5.8:1 on eco-night, 5.1:1 on the dark solid card. 2.8:1 on `surface-selected` peach: a control inside a selected row takes `ink-muted` as its edge.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: the one filled orange action per area.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a filled action.

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Press on a filled action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action fills (Amber, 5 October 2026, C08). Never white.

tokens.name: ai-surface
tokens.usage: The AI mark and AI-owned tiles. Never a page.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour, drawn solid by `focus-ring`. 4.5:1 on white and 4.1:1 on Shell in Sunrise; 7.6:1 on eco-night. Replaces the App Design System's 50% orange ring, which measured 1.6:1 (C09: 3:1 on edges and icons). Confirmed by Amber, 5 October 2026.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop: the App Design System's 70% black, in Deep Eco on light. Confirmed by Amber, 5 October 2026.

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: Large glow, top left in Sunrise: 1000px Crisp Orange disc at 15%. Top right in dark: Current (Deep Eco) or berry plum (Twilight) at 15%, 820px. Glow discs never exceed 15% opacity (Amber, 6 October 2026, from the 3 October feedback: little colour, low saturation).

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Warm glow, bottom right in Sunrise: 820px Crisp Orange disc at 15%. Bottom left in dark: 560px at 12%. Capped at 15% (Amber, 6 October 2026).

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Cool counterweight: a 700px Current disc at 12% top right in Sunrise; an Eco Green disc at 15% on the right in Deep Eco; a faint Current disc at 12% in Twilight. Capped at 15% (Amber, 6 October 2026). The eleven backgrounds in backgrounds.css keep their measured values.

tokens.name: status-on-track
tokens.usage: On track. Circle with a tick. White glyph in light (4.9:1), Deep Eco glyph in dark (5.3:1). State only, never a chart series.

tokens.name: status-on-track-soft
tokens.usage: On track chip fill. Quietest of the three: tinted, no edge, `ink` label.

tokens.name: status-at-risk
tokens.usage: At risk. Triangle with an exclamation. White glyph in light (3.2:1, graphic only), Deep Eco glyph in dark (5.8:1). Replaces the App Design System's warning #ffcb00 (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: status-at-risk-soft
tokens.usage: At risk chip fill, with status-at-risk-edge. Louder than On track.

tokens.name: status-at-risk-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inset edge on the At risk chip.

tokens.name: status-overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue. Octagon with a clock. White glyph in light (4.5:1), Deep Eco glyph in dark (5.2:1). The same red as the App Design System's negative.

tokens.name: status-overdue-fill
tokens.usage: Overdue chip: solid fill with a white label and white octagon (4.5:1). Same in every theme, since white on the dark status-overdue is 3.4:1.

tokens.name: status-complete
tokens.usage: Complete: Eco Green circle with a tick (StatusIcon). Not started is a dashed `ink-muted` ring.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Glyph colour inside status icons.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (Current). Fixed order, never cycled.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second series: Crisp Orange deepened to clear 3:1 on white.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third series: plum lifted so it reads as a colour.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series: ochre.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series: slate blue.

tokens.name: series-other
tokens.usage: A sixth category folds into Other in this neutral (ReportColours).

families.display: Outfit, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.body: Onest, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Which job is one phone call away from moving?
styles.usage: The landing question, up to two lines (LandingQuestion).

styles.name: hero-mobile
styles.sample: What do you need on site today?

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. Vibe's scale, kept for the Hub (Amber, 4 October 2026, C01 and C03).

styles.name: text1
styles.sample: Assign a crew before publishing the schedule.
styles.usage: Body copy in the Hub, in Onest. Weights 400, 500, 600 and 700 only (Amber, 5 October 2026, C05).

styles.name: text2
styles.usage: Table cells, menu items, field values. 600 for emphasis.

styles.name: text3
styles.usage: Captions, counts and the smallest label. No type step below 12px.

styles.name: prompt
styles.sample: Ask about any job, or tell Lofty what to do

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card and row titles in chat surfaces.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting lines and timestamps, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels inside panels, sentence case.

styles.name: brand-display
styles.usage: Decks, print and brand-led hero statements. Fieldwork Geo DemiBold.

styles.name: brand-body
styles.usage: Body copy on brand-led surfaces. Fieldwork Hum Light; the brand faces ship only in 300 and 600.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: the gap between a focus ring and its control, a dot and its label (App Design System).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips and adjacent controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between starter cards and inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Frame padding, gap between rail and panels, card padding, compact tiles.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Panel padding and frame inset from the page edge.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between stacked widgets; content card padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between the landing question, prompt box and starter row; page gutters.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Control height on desktop; nav row height (App Design System).

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Side padding of the conversation column; the largest button.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Condensed rail width; section breaks on long pages (App Design System).

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Hero and cover spacing on brand-led surfaces (App Design System).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Dense controls: checkboxes, menu items, small tags, table controls (the App Design System's `--border-radius-small`). Amber, 5 October 2026 (kept) and 6 October 2026 (the 3 October scale applies).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons (send, voice), segmented controls, status chips that are not pills. Amber, 6 October 2026: buttons are 8px, not pills.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards: starter cards, answer widgets, glance cards, chat bubbles; also rail rows and icon tiles. Amber, 6 October 2026.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Panels: the rail, the Your day panel, the prompt box, modals (Vibe's big radius). Amber, 6 October 2026; reinstates the 16px step dropped on 5 October.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The frosted app frame; same value as `radius-frame`. Amber, 6 October 2026.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: The frosted app frame only (was 28px). Amber, 6 October 2026.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips (tool chips, status chips, filter chips) and Search only. Never a button (Amber, 6 October 2026, from the 3 October feedback "Momentum is too round"). Toggles and progress tracks keep their natural pill shape.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Avatars, radios, loaders, status circles (App Design System; kept by Amber, 5 October 2026).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Row hover lift (App Design System).

tokens.name: shadow-s
tokens.usage: Dropdowns and a board card on hover (App Design System).

tokens.name: shadow-m
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts and tooltips (App Design System).

tokens.name: shadow-l
tokens.usage: Modals (App Design System).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The prompt box and anything that floats over glass.

tokens.name: shadow-ai
tokens.usage: The plum AI mark on the landing page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Visible focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then a 2px solid ring in `focus`. Never removed, never replaced by a colour change alone. Confirmed by Amber, 5 October 2026.

blur.note: Backdrop and glow blur radii. Glass needs a coloured glow behind it or it reads as grey.

tokens.name: blur-frame
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on the app frame.

tokens.name: blur-input
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on the prompt box and floating bars.

tokens.name: blur-glow
tokens.usage: filter blur on the background glow discs, which sit at 15% opacity or less (Amber, 6 October 2026).

zIndex.note: Layer scale, never a literal (App Design System).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the top bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown lists and combobox panels.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips and tipseens.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, modals and the backdrop.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and alert banners.
